en.text: As the deer pants for the water brooks,
My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

zhSimplified.text: 我的心渴想 神，就是永生 神；

zhTraditional.text: 我的心渴想上帝，就是永生上帝；

en.text: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.
My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

zhSimplified.text: 我的 神啊，我的心在我里面忧闷， 地， ，从记念你。

zhTraditional.text: 我的上帝啊，我的心在我裏面憂悶， 地， ，從記念你。

en.text: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

zhSimplified.text: 你的瀑布发声，深渊就与深渊响应；

zhTraditional.text: 你的瀑布發聲，深淵就與深淵響應；

en.text: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

footnotes.text: 42:8 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 白昼，耶和华必向我施慈爱；

zhTraditional.text: 白晝，耶和華必向我施慈愛；

en.text: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

zhSimplified.text: 我要对 神—我的磐石说：

zhTraditional.text: 我要對上帝－我的磐石說：

en.text: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”
Why are you in despair, my soul? are you disturbed within me? in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

zhSimplified.text: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？ ，是我的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 我的心哪，你為何憂悶？ ，是我的上帝。
